placement: Federation host and site modules — follow-up to WI-0030, approved by the owner on 2026-09-30 (kemiller2002/limen#19). src/federation.ts decodes every manifest it registers and every dispatch result a module returns with the generated strict codec, so malformed module output is an InvalidEnvelope or InvalidManifest error naming the path instead of reaching routing. The site's F# federation modules (site/fsharp/federation/*) use the generated F# bindings (guests/fsharp/Limen.Contract) for manifests, initialization, envelopes and dispatch results instead of hand-built JSON; their own payloads and snapshots stay theirs.
